blocks.text: Original document: [docs/SPRING_PHYSICS_AND_DYNAMIC_BINDING_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/SPRING_PHYSICS_AND_DYNAMIC_BINDING_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
Harmonic oscillators, mass-spring-damper simulations, and mechanical physics animations require a dedicated spring entity that updates dynamically as masses move.

items: **Multiple Visual Styles**: Supports classic physics zigzag coils, smooth helical sine waves, and rigid connecting rods.

**Dynamic Entity Attachment**: Dynamically connects two independent [`Entity`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Entity.ts) instances via local anchor points, automatically recalculating length, orientation angle, elongation, and compression each frame.

**Reactive Scene Hooking**: Can attach directly to a [`Scene`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Scene.ts) instance to execute zero-allocation vertex rebuilding inside the continuous animation loop.
